answers.notes: Claim c06 of ch03 (source s1, p. 60) states most jute mills are located mainly along the banks of the Hugli river. No claim supports the Damodar, Teesta, or western-plateau options.
answers.quote: Most of the mills are located in West Bengal, mainly along the banks of the Hugli river, in a narrow belt.

answers.notes: Claim c06 of ch07 (source s1, p. 60) states the first jute mill was set up at Rishra in 1855. Distractors are other claim topics: Mumbai = first cotton textile mill (c11), Chittaranjan = locomotive works (c37-c40), Haldia = industrial park/port (c28-c29); none is the first jute mill.
answers.quote: The first jute mill was set up near Kolkata in 1855 at Rishra.
